title: Relation
description: A typed link between two entities (D2, E14). Adding and removing are idempotent and never conflict (D18). Tagging is a tagged Relation from an item to a tag. Open: clients ignore members they do not know.

type.description: Known types are the examples; a newer Hub may send others, which a client keeps but does not interpret. Creating a Relation takes only the known ones.

locators.description: Where in the original the link rests, for an evidence Relation the Hub made when the user accepted a Suggestion: the Hub copies them from the Suggestion's evidence, one Relation per anchor, and joins them with those already there (D10, E14). Each Locator's anchor (blob or capture) is to; a Relation of another known type has none (rule locator_anchor). A client never writes it.

tagged_ends.description: A tagged Relation goes from an item to a tag.
